scope: Removes the asynchronous CookieManager read-back loop that left the Login page stuck on Securing your HealthyMe session

Keeps the existing Retry secure session fallback only for exceptional browser-script failure

No assessment, report, recommendation, schedule or member-data contract change
No password, access token or refresh token stored in browser cookies, URLs or local storage
